findings.title: Handle persisted expired intents when restarting an uncommitted upload
findings.evidence_kind: static source trace; reviewer did not execute a reproduction
findings.body: After an interrupted uncommitted upload, existing expireUploads() legitimately changes its database status from created/uploaded to expired (repository.ts:1177-1182). Same-request create returns that existing intent unchanged (repository.ts:701-728). The Portal restart branch only accepts status created, so status expired skips it and calls finalize, which correctly refuses non-created intents (server-fns.ts:369). catch marks the same journal request uncertain and each retry reuses it indefinitely. Thus a normal maintenance-expired attempt cannot restart through this UI. Treat an authoritative expired status with documentId null as the explicit expired/uncommitted restart state, while preserving committed/uncertain attempts.
findings.required_regression: Create an unfinished attempt, have the server return status expired with documentId null on retry/reload, assert no finalize for the expired intent and explicit retry starts one fresh request; committed attempts must still replay their original receipt.

findings.title: Honor the explicitly selected resume request before the per-file attempt cache
findings.evidence_kind: static source trace; reviewer did not execute a reproduction
findings.body: With two uncertain files A and B in the current mounted panel, fileAttempts retains both entries. Choose Continue this upload for B, then mistakenly reselect the original A file. uploadOne picks cached A before the resumeId-selected B, so matchesUploadFile validates A against itself, calls the RPCs for A, and clears resumeId on success. The user selected B but a different attempt was confirmed instead of showing the promised original-file mismatch. This can also silently retain the wrong checklist/category. Resolve an explicit resumeId first and validate the selected bytes against that request; only fall back to the per-file retry cache when no explicit resume is selected.
findings.required_regression: Without remounting, retain two uncertain attempts A/B, select B and reselect A; expect file mismatch before any further RPC and B still resumable. Then select the correct B file and assert only B request/checklist/category is sent.
